description: Create an Airflow DAG 'customer_360_build' for telecom_co that depends on two upstream DAGs with different schedules: 'billing_export' (daily at 01:00 UTC) and 'usage_rollup' (hourly). The DAG runs daily at 04:00 UTC and must: (1) wait with ExternalTaskSensor for billing_export's final task for the same data date, (2) wait for the usage_rollup run covering the last hour (23:00-24:00) of the data date, (3) build the customer_360 table, (4) run validation. Both sensors use reschedule mode, time out after 3 hours, and must fail fast if the upstream task is in a failed state.
edge_cases: execution_delta is subtracted from this DAG's logical date: 04:00 minus 3h equals the 01:00 logical date of billing_export for the same day
The usage_rollup run that covers 23:00-24:00 has logical date 23:00 of the data date, which is 19 hours after this DAG's 04:00 logical date (negative delta)
failed_states must be set, otherwise the sensor polls until timeout when the upstream has already failed
upstream skipped state must not be treated as success
common_failure_modes: FM6: Omitting execution_delta makes the sensor look for an upstream run at 04:00 that never exists
FM2: Waiting for the 00:00 usage_rollup run of the data date builds customer_360 with one hour of usage instead of 24
FM6: No failed_states means a failed upstream burns the full 3-hour timeout before alerting
